rules.name: Login From a New Source for an Established User
rules.description: An account with an established login history signed in from an address it has never used.
rules.logic: A successful login from a new source, after at least 5 logins from other sources
rules.explanation: {user} logged in from {src_ip}, a source not seen in {baseline_logins} earlier logins from {known_sources} known source(s).
recommendations: Confirm with the account owner that this login was expected.

rules.name: Outbound Volume Far Above This Host's Baseline
rules.description: A single transfer was far larger than this address normally sends.
rules.logic: One transfer of 10 MB or more, at least 3 deviations above at least 10 earlier transfers
rules.explanation: {src_ip} sent {observed_size_mb:.1f} MB in one transfer, {deviations:.0f} deviations above its average of {baseline_mean_mb:.2f} MB over {baseline_events} earlier transfers.
recommendations: Review what this host sent, and to where.

rules.name: Login Outside This User's Usual Hours
rules.description: An account with a regular pattern of login times signed in well outside it.
rules.logic: A login at least 3 hours outside a span of 10 hours or fewer that holds at least 10 earlier logins
rules.explanation: {user} logged in at {login_hour} UTC. Their {baseline_logins} earlier logins were all between {usual_start} and {usual_end} UTC.
recommendations: Confirm with the account owner that this login was expected.
